title: Renaming a tier to a taken name keeps the old name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click tier A's name at the top of the page.
  4. Type tier B's name.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Click outside the name field.
  7. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name can be edited.

Step 4:

  • The field shows tier B's name.

Step 5:

  • An inline error shows under the name.
  • It reads "A tier called" followed by tier B's name, "already exists. Click away to keep" and tier A's name.

Step 6:

  • The title shows tier A's own name again.

Step 7:

  • After the reload the title is tier A's own name.
